title: 🗣️ Сплетни: расскажи о друге
description: Ученик А рассказывает о себе, а ты передаёшь это как «сплетню» в 3-м лице: I play → He plays.

items.sentence: He ___ like waking up early. (I don't like waking up early.)
He ___ all his pocket money on snacks. (I spend all my pocket money on snacks.)
She always ___ her parents with shopping. (I always help my parents with shopping.)
He ___ do his homework on Fridays. (I don't do my homework on Fridays.)
She ___ with her friends online every evening. (I chat with my friends online every evening.)
He ___ horror films alone. (I watch horror films alone.)
She ___ eat meat. (I don't eat meat.)
He ___ to the dentist twice a year. (I go to the dentist twice a year.)
She ___ English because she wants to travel. (I study English because I want to travel.)
He sometimes ___ with his best friend. (I sometimes argue with my best friend.)
She ___ like playing sports. (I don't like playing sports.)
He ___ detective novels in bed. (I read detective novels in bed.)
She ___ her dog for a walk twice a day. (I take my dog for a walk twice a day.)
He ___ trust strangers on the Internet. (I don't trust strangers on the Internet.)
She ___ of becoming a famous blogger. (I dream of becoming a famous blogger.)
